headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory. Jesús Luzardo led the way with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 and allowing 2 earned runs. In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Cease earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 0 ER, 4 BB, 4 H. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI, and 3 AB.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Spencer Strider, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Chase DeLauter has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right side rib fracture, while Max Scherzer is out with back spasms. Gleyber Torres has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain, and Will Wilson has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left thumb fracture.

The Kansas City Royals traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, and the Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Cruise Past Marlins 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory. Jesús Luzardo led the way with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged the Kansas City Royals 6-4, securing a crucial win. Curtis Mead led the Royals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Cease earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 0 ER, 4 BB, 4 H. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI, and 3 AB, including a key home run that scored Myles Straw.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Dominate Reds in 9-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a decisive win over the Cincinnati Reds, finishing the game with a 9-1 final score. Nolan McLean was among the standout performers for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Nationals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Carter Jensen and Michael Massey contributing to the winning effort. Lane Thomas and John Rave also had notable performances for their respective teams.

top_news.title: **Strider Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves right-handed pitcher Spencer Strider has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Angels Acquire Heineman in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels have acquired catcher Tyler Heineman in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The deal was made for cash considerations.
